# Lantern of Ash

A wondrous item that requires attunement, with its weight and cost.
Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: 5e_2014
  card-type: item
data:
  name: Lantern of Ash
  category: Wondrous item
  rarity: uncommon
  attunement: true
  weight: 2 lb.
  cost: 400 gp
  description: While lit, this brass lantern sheds dim grey light in a 20-foot radius. Invisible creatures in that light leave faint trails of ash, and you have advantage on checks to track them.
```
